scopeNote: Section 8 was written to specify the ordering contract for a NEW same-day presence authority. Under the supervisor scope amendment no such authority is built, so this records the EXISTING daily ordering that a future daily mobility / party-overlap / encounter checkpoint must build on.

registry.whyLeafModule: trips before expeditions on a shared day; a module-initialization cycle would capture an undefined handler depending on bundler init order, which is import-order-dependent nondeterminism

questions.whenAreSameDayPartiesSelected: applyTripDay (intraSeasonTrips.ts:244), per band, loop at :260 over Object.values(world.bands).sort(compareBands)
questions.whichWorldSnapshotSelectsThem: selectTripCandidate(currentWorld, ...) at :265 — currentWorld, not world: the band SET is frozen, the STATE is already mutated by earlier bands the same day
questions.isThatIntendedPhysicalSequence: intended and documented at intraSeasonTrips.ts:251-255 as shared-catchment competition in deterministic sorted band order
questions.whenIsDailyPhysicalPresenceVisible: never — there is no daily physical-presence read model; getBandPhysicalPresence is consumed only through a TickContextCache, and every buildTickContextCache call site is inside runSeasonalCompatibilityTick
questions.whenDoesItExpire: not applicable — nothing ephemeral is stored; multi-day presence is derived on demand from band.expeditions and ends exactly when the phase becomes terminal
questions.canCrowdingAndSharedUseReadTheSamePlan: they read the same AUTHORITY (getBandPhysicalPresence) from the same seasonal cache, which is why field/scan parity holds; there is no plan because there is no daily read model

labourNonReusePoints: intraSeasonTrips.ts:247-250 tripWorkersByBandId — the investigation party is staffed from what the ordinary trip left
expedition.ts reconcileExpeditionCommitment (CORRECTION-34A) — daily, covers workforce collapse after a legal launch

orderDependence.dailyBandIterationOrder: fixed canonical sort (compareBands / compareExpeditionBands); no injectable permutation seam exists
orderDependence.dailyOrderSensitivity: order-SENSITIVE by design (earlier bands deplete first) but not order-AMBIGUOUS (the order never varies between runs)
orderDependence.seasonalBandOrderPermutation: covered by seasonOrderInvarianceAudit — physical/causal state byte-identical under ascending/descending/permuted; PASS
orderDependence.presenceReadModelOrderDependence: structurally none — getBandPhysicalPresence(band) takes one band, no world, no cache, no iteration order

singleDailyAuthority.labour: getResidentialWorkingAdults / deriveAvailableMobilityPools, reconciled daily by reconcileExpeditionCommitment
singleDailyAuthority.physicalPresence: getBandPhysicalPresence — derived on demand, consumed seasonally
singleDailyAuthority.dailyPhysicalPresenceAuthority: DOES NOT EXIST AND IS NOT CREATED BY CORRECTION-34A — see SAME_DAY_PRESENCE_SEAM.md section 3 for the six requirements a future one must meet
